runs.question: October me gamlay me palak kaise lagayen?
runs.answer: Taza pani 2 baar lagao, subah ke waqt aur raat bhar.

runs.question: Dhania ko kitna pani dena chahiye?
runs.answer: Khabar! Ye sawal kitab mein nahi hai. Buntu! Ye sawal nursey wale se chahiye!

runs.question: Kya July me tamatar laga sakte hain Karachi me?
runs.answer: Ye nahi. July me Karachi phoolon mein khatra hai. Buntu hai.

runs.question: Chicken biryani banane ka tareeqa batao.
When should I plant carrots in Karachi?
Karachi me sab se saste beej kahan se milenge?
